evidence.claim: A batch of N=12 with one deliberately hung unit: naive parallel() does not resolve within the watchdog and writes zero durable rows; the per-unit pipeline barrier resolves with 11 SUCCESS + 1 typed timeout classification.

The hung unit is classified timeout-0.2s and is present in the fan-in set (not silently dropped). Survivors are complete, attributed by unit_id, and durable on disk before the hung unit is classified (write-as-you-go).

failure_class: one hung unit blocks a large batch

negative_controls.description: all-healthy cohort: N SUCCESS, zero timeout classifications, wall under the negative budget; hung injection fires timeout

question_or_target: Failure class :11317. Measured: parallel() has no per-agent timeout, so one hung agent deadlocks the whole phase - detected only by a write-freeze longer than 25 minutes. Target: per-unit timeouts and a per-work-unit pipeline so the barrier resolves on the survivors with the hung unit classified, not silently awaited.

residual_unknowns.claim: This unit measures the barrier contract on the SUT under probes/TST-0091/. Production parallel() call sites in operator workflows (WFA-0088 / IMP-0452) are not patched here.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: WFA-0088 repair of live workflow parallel() call sites.

retry.policy: NO retry. A retry masks the exact instability this unit exists to measure; a failed run is the datum, re-run only with a changed hypothesis recorded first

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-runs classification, survivor attribution, and the all-healthy negative control, and recounts the ledger. It does not author the naive watchdog.
